inspiration.observed_pattern: MariaDB adds an inline LIMIT clause to GROUP_CONCAT so an ordered aggregate can retain only its top-ranked values.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a bounded tag leaderboard. GROUP_CONCAT combines DISTINCT duplicate elimination, deterministic score/name ordering, and an inline LIMIT 2 so repeated labels cannot consume multiple top slots. The release-note wording, examples, schema, labels, and scores are not copied.

fixture_notes: Segment 41 repeats alpha at two scores, so DISTINCT must retain alpha once before LIMIT 2 selects alpha and beta. Segment 42 repeats delta and ties delta with epsilon at the selected boundary; label ordering makes the result deterministic.
determinism_notes: Segment IDs, labels, scores, aggregate ordering, separator, DISTINCT, and LIMIT are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE segment_tag_events (tag_event_id INT PRIMARY KEY, segment_id INT NOT NULL, tag_name VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, tag_score INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT segment_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT tag_name ORDER BY tag_score DESC, tag_name ASC SEPARATOR '|' LIMIT 2) AS top_tags FROM segment_tag_events GROUP BY segment_id ORDER BY segment_id

checks.sql: SELECT tag_event_id, segment_id, tag_name, tag_score FROM segment_tag_events ORDER BY tag_event_id
